desks.headline: Dominic wins the week on 75 as Ayodele holds top spot
desks.text: **Dominic** won the week with **75**, the best score of the gameweek, while **Ayodele** still tops the table on 700, 8 clear of Cherag. Haaland blanked for 21 managers, and Hishaan's **Barry** armband hauled 32 to lift him 5 places to 9th. We said N.Jackson's haul could let Bhavik pass Ravi, and it did.

plots.title: Ayodele Edges Back Ahead
plots.text: Ayodele has retaken the lead at 700 points, 8 ahead of Cherag on 692, after Cherag held the top spot for GW5 to GW9. The crown has changed hands 4 times this season, and Sid sits 29 points off the leader in third.
plots.next: Could Cherag strike back, or can Ayodele stay top for a second week?
plots.question: Who can hold the crown?

plots.title: Nihal Holds 4th
plots.text: Nihal has climbed from 26th in GW1 to 4th, a rise of 22 places, and has held that spot for 2 weeks. The climb has been steady since GW5, when Nihal was 16th.
plots.next: Could Nihal push into the top 3, or will the climb stall here?
plots.question: How high can Nihal go?

plots.title: Tobi's Long Slump
plots.text: Tobi has now been below the league average for 6 weeks in a row, with a low of 37 points in GW9. A 58-point GW10 is a sign of life, but the run is still going.
plots.next: Could a 58-point week be the start of a way out of the slump?
plots.question: Can Tobi snap out of it?

plots.title: Justin's Slide Continues
plots.text: Justin has dropped from 7th in GW6 to 17th, having bottomed out at 18th in GW9. A single place back in GW10 is the first hint of a turn.
plots.next: Could Justin claw back towards the top 10, or slide further?
plots.question: Can Justin stop the slide?

plots.title: Edd Keeps Rolling
plots.text: Edd has been above the league average for 6 weeks in a row, dipping to 49 points in GW8 before returning to 67 in GW10. The streak has survived a wobble and is still intact.
plots.next: Could Edd reach a 7th straight week above average, or will the run end?
plots.question: How long can Edd stay hot?

gamble:3506595:10.title: Hishaan's Bold Armband
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan backed Barry as captain, a choice only one manager made, and it returned 32 points. The gamble lifted Hishaan from 14th to 8th while most managers followed Haaland, who was captained by 21.

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Armband Pays Off
gamble:3506595:10.text: Hishaan's lone Barry armband paid off with 32 points, a gamble only one manager took. The move has carried Hishaan up to 9th from 14th, while 21 managers followed Haaland.

chase:4922092.title: Ravi Closes In
chase:4922092.text: Ravi has chased Bhavik down from 32 points behind in GW7 to 14 in GW8 and then just 1 in GW9. Live in GW10, the pair are now level.

gold.title: Fight for the Gold
gold.text: Only 4 spots sit in the Gold zone, and Nihal currently holds the last one. Nanik is first out, 5 points behind, and both have spent 2 of the last 5 weeks inside the zone.

rivalry:3506595-7471754.title: Hishaan vs Tonna
rivalry:3506595-7471754.text: Hishaan and Tonna have swapped places 6 times this season, and Tonna once led by 31 points in GW8. Live in GW10, Hishaan has pulled back ahead by 8.
